SELECT json_build_object(
  'overdue', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.deadline ASC) FROM (
    SELECT a.id::text AS assignment_id, a.role, a.scope, a.status, a.deadline,
      (CURRENT_DATE - a.deadline)::int AS days_overdue,
      a.fee_eur, c.name AS collaborator_name, c.email AS collaborator_email, c.specialty,
      p.id::text AS project_id, p.name AS project_name
    FROM collab_assignments a
    JOIN collaborators c ON c.id = a.collaborator_id
    JOIN projects p ON p.id = a.project_id
    WHERE a.deadline IS NOT NULL
      AND a.deadline < CURRENT_DATE
      AND a.status NOT IN ('approved', 'closed', 'cancelled', 'rejected', 'rejected_delivery')
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'stale_delivered', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.delivered_at ASC) FROM (
    SELECT a.id::text AS assignment_id, a.role, a.scope, a.status, a.delivered_at,
      floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - a.delivered_at))/86400)::int AS days_since_delivery,
      a.fee_eur, c.name AS collaborator_name, c.email AS collaborator_email,
      p.id::text AS project_id, p.name AS project_name
    FROM collab_assignments a
    JOIN collaborators c ON c.id = a.collaborator_id
    JOIN projects p ON p.id = a.project_id
    WHERE a.status = 'delivered'
      AND a.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
      AND a.delivered_at < now() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'invited_no_response', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.invited_at ASC) FROM (
    SELECT a.id::text AS assignment_id, a.role, a.scope, a.invited_at,
      floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - a.invited_at))/86400)::int AS days_since_invite,
      c.name AS collaborator_name, c.email AS collaborator_email,
      p.id::text AS project_id, p.name AS project_name
    FROM collab_assignments a
    JOIN collaborators c ON c.id = a.collaborator_id
    JOIN projects p ON p.id = a.project_id
    WHERE a.status = 'invited'
      AND a.invited_at < now() - INTERVAL '5 days'
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'total_issues', (
    (SELECT count(*) FROM collab_assignments WHERE deadline IS NOT NULL AND deadline < CURRENT_DATE AND status NOT IN ('approved','closed','cancelled','rejected','rejected_delivery'))
  + (SELECT count(*) FROM collab_assignments WHERE status = 'delivered' AND delivered_at < now() - INTERVAL '7 days')
  + (SELECT count(*) FROM collab_assignments WHERE status = 'invited' AND invited_at < now() - INTERVAL '5 days')
  )::int
) AS report;
